## MainDomElementMixin(superClass)

set render context for lit element to main DOM instead of the
default shadow root

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `superClass` | `Class` | LitElement or child class. |

**Returns:** `Class` - LitElement updated createRenderRoot function.

### Methods

#### createRenderRoot()
